blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: reconocer los verbos de estado que con otro significado sí llevan -ing
formular con cortesía y prudencia usando el pasado (I was wondering)
usar las diferencias sutiles entre simple y continuous

blocks.text: 1. Verbos de estado con dos significados

head: Verbo
Estado (simple)
Acción (continuous)
rows: I'm seeing the doctor at four. (cita)
She's appearing in a new film. (actuar)

blocks.title: He's being silly = está haciendo el tonto
blocks.text: be en continuous describe un comportamiento temporal, no el carácter, algo parecido a ser frente a estar: He is rude = es maleducado; He's being rude = se está portando de forma maleducada. You're being very quiet today = hoy estás muy callado (no es lo normal).

Con always, constantly, forever + continuous te quejas de algo que pasa a menudo, igual que siempre está ... en español: He's always leaving his socks on the floor! (¡Siempre está dejando los calcetines en el suelo!) You're constantly interrupting me. La misma frase en simple es neutra: He always leaves at eight.
3. El pasado para la distancia y la cortesía

head: Inglés
Efecto
rows: I was wondering if you could help me.
I wanted to ask you something.
más suave que I want to ask
ofrecimiento educado en una tienda o un bar
I was hoping we could talk.
una esperanza que no se cumplió

blocks.title: Quería preguntarte ... = I wanted to ask you ...
blocks.text: El español también suaviza con el pasado: Quería preguntarte si ..., Me preguntaba si ... El inglés va aún más lejos con el continuous: I was just wondering whether ... es la forma más educada de pedir algo.

head: Simple
Continuous
rows: I'm living in Bristol for now. (temporal)
I've been reading your report. (en curso, quizá sin terminar)
What did you do last night? (la acción)
What were you doing at nine? (en curso en un momento)
We'll be seeing you soon. (natural, informal)
She is having a lot of money.
She has a lot of money.
I wonder if you can help me.
I was wondering if you could help me.
Lo más educado, con el pasado.

blocks.text: Completa con el simple o el continuous. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.full: I am thinking about changing my job.
I think you're making a mistake.
We were having dinner when you called.

items.q: You ______ very quiet today. Is anything wrong?
items.full: You are being very quiet today. Is anything wrong?

items.q: I was ______ if you could give me some advice.
items.full: I was wondering if you could give me some advice.

items.q: I ______ the dentist tomorrow at ten.
items.full: I am seeing the dentist tomorrow at ten.

items.q: She ______ in a flat until her house is ready.
items.full: She is living in a flat until her house is ready.

items.q: ¡Siempre está dejando los calcetines en el suelo!
items.a: He's always leaving his socks on the floor!

items.q: Me preguntaba si me podría ayudar.
items.a: I was wondering if you could help me.
